issues.display_title: Issue #42: feat(copilot): support slash commands integration (/archive, /transfer, /download, /tag, /delete, /create-tour, /navigate)
issues.main_description_html:
Overview

Support frontend slash commands (/archive, /transfer, /download, /tag, /delete, /create-tour, /navigate) in GoThru RAG Copilot planner, enabling rapid command execution, modal actions, and destination navigation directly from Ask AI chat.

Key Requirements & Scope

  • Slash Command Token Matching (app/copilot/planner.py):
    • Update _is_imperative_client_action to treat commands starting with / as imperative client actions rather than informational queries.
    • Expand _DOWNLOAD_TOUR_PATTERN, _ADD_TOUR_TAG_PATTERN, and _DELETE_TOUR_PATTERN to recognize /download, /tag, and /delete (standalone and followed by [Tour: ...] or @tour).
    • Enable /create-tour to open the create_tour_menu modal with auto_trigger: true.
  • Workspace & Global Navigation (/navigate):
    • Global navigation destinations:
      • /navigate storage -> /storage
      • /navigate my-tours / /navigate my tours -> /my-tours
    • Tour workspace destinations with active or mentioned tour:
      • /navigate upload -> /my-tours/{tour_id}/upload
      • /navigate edit -> /my-tours/{tour_id}/edit
      • /navigate hosted / /navigate vt -> /my-tours/{tour_id}/hosted
      • /navigate publish -> /my-tours/{tour_id}/publish
    • Direct tour navigation:
      • /navigate @Tour or /navigate [Tour: ...] -> navigates to /my-tours/{target_tour_id} when on another route.
    • Context validation & clarification:
      • Return needs_context with available workspace list if /navigate is issued without destination.
      • Return needs_context asking for tour specification if workspace route requires a tour context.
  • Zero-Latency Clarification Response (app/copilot/answerer.py):
    • Return immediate guidance response without unnecessary LLM invocation when needs_context is generated for missing navigation destination or missing tour.
  • Analytics & Intent Normalization (app/copilot/analytics.py):
    • Classify queries starting with / as execute_action intent.
    • Map slash actions directly to their respective feature categories (Archive Tour, Transfer Tour, Download Tour, Add Tour Tags, Delete Tour, Create New Tour, Navigation).
  • Unit & Regression Testing (tests/copilot/):
    • Add comprehensive unit test test_planner_slash_commands_all_cases and async planner test covering all 7 commands.
    • Add analytics intent and feature resolution tests for slash commands.
    • Verify all 250 tests pass with zero regressions.

Results & Verification

  • Automated Tests: 250 passed in test suite (tests/).
  • End-to-End Compatibility: Seamless integration with frontend gothru-dashboard slash commands hook (useSlashCommand).
